newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market slow, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market slow, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared with Friday's close, USDA said.
Trade was slow. Demand and seller interest light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
